choices: She was an Egyptian handmaid, from the servants Pharaoh gave Abram
She was from Ur of the Chaldees
questions.explain: Pharaoh gave Abram menservants and maidservants (Genesis 12:16).

questions.q: What did the angel of the Lord tell Hagar at the fountain?
choices: Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands
Flee to the wilderness of Paran
Take your son and go to Abram

questions.q: According to the class, should this account be used to justify taking multiple wives?
choices: No; Abram's purpose was the promised seed, and he kept the laws
Only if the first wife agrees
questions.explain: Abram said, thy maid is in thy hand; he had no attachment to Hagar. His sole purpose was the seed.

questions.q: Who did Ishmael become the ancestor of?
choices: The desert tribes from Sinai to southern Jordan; the Arabs venerate him as their forefather
questions.explain: Ishmael was Abram's firstborn, but the covenant goes through the twelve tribes of Israel.
